questions.prompt: In a standard limit order book, which price level is the **best bid**?
questions.explanation: Best bid is the highest price at which someone is willing to buy.
Quoted spread is typically best ask − best bid.

questions.prompt:
Which statements about FIFO matching (at a price level) are typically true?

- Select all that apply

options.text: Earlier orders at the same price generally match first
Largest order always matches before smaller ones at same price
Better prices still have priority over worse prices
Match order is uniformly random among all prices

questions.explanation: Price-time priority: better price first, then earlier time at that price.

questions.prompt: A buy order that executes immediately against resting sell liquidity is typically called a ____ order (one word).
questions.explanation: A market order is intended for immediate execution against available liquidity.
